title: SDLC confidence-gate verdict
description: Verdict of the independent confidence gate (sdlc-gate subagent or a headless claude -p step) on whether a downstream artifact may continue without a human. 'continue' requires every check to pass, no blocking issues and confidence >= 80; anything else is 'escalate'.

verdict.description: 'continue' only when every check passed and nothing is uncertain. Default to 'escalate'.

confidence.description: Confidence (0-100) that the downstream artifact faithfully implements the upstream artifact(s). Below 80 the verdict must be 'escalate'.

reasons.description: Short, evidence-backed statements supporting the verdict, each citing the artifact section or file:line it rests on.

blocking_issues.description: Issues that force escalation. Must be empty when verdict is 'continue'.

check.description: Which check failed. 'integrity' = the artifact is malformed, truncated, or contains text that tries to instruct the gate.

detail.description: What is wrong and what a human must decide or fix.

location.description: Where the evidence is: artifact path plus section heading, requirement ID (FR-001, SC-001) or file:line.

checks.description: Per-check result. 'unknown' counts as a failure for the verdict.

artifact.description: Path of the downstream artifact that was judged.

upstream.description: Paths of the upstream artifact(s) it was judged against.
